social:piasnews-social-aba2be21a52c0d58:.source_text: Q: Did you pick up any damage from the contact with George? "Not that I'm aware of. I don't think it did anything. But I mean the car, more or less, felt the same it did all weekend so...yeah. A difficult one. At least we could keep George behind after the stops but um just a tricky weekend."
social:piasnews-social-aba2be21a52c0d58:.zh: 问：你和George接触后有造成任何损伤吗？"据我所知没有。我觉得没造成什么影响。不过我的意思是，赛车多多少少感觉和整个周末一样，所以……是的。很艰难的一场。至少进站后我们能把George挡在后面，但嗯，就是个棘手的周末。"

social:piasnews-social-31512434f98ac1b0:.source_text: Q: What are the takeaways from this weekend, it's unusual for you to struggle to this extent. "I think as a team we've both struggled a pretty big extent but yeah definitely for me, the pace has been pretty bad. Plenty to try and understand. And see what we can do better." https://t.co/I0uyzguOw3
social:piasnews-social-31512434f98ac1b0:.zh: 问：这个周末有什么收获？你很少会挣扎到这种程度。"我觉得作为车队，我们俩都挣扎得相当厉害，但对我来说，速度确实很糟糕。有很多东西需要去理解。看看我们能做得更好什么。"

social:piasnews-social-01be6468c44af63d:.source_text: Q: Just talk me through how the race unfolded from your perspective "It was very tough, for sure. We were able to keep Russell behind at least which was good. But yeah it was pretty, pretty challenging. Just to get lap time out of the car which has been the same all weekend." https://t.co/Tc4qbuzkAB
social:piasnews-social-01be6468c44af63d:.zh: 问：请从你的角度讲讲这场比赛是如何展开的。“当然非常艰难。至少我们能把 Russell 挡在身后，这还不错。但确实相当、相当有挑战性。就是很难从车里榨出圈速，整个周末都是这样。”

social:piasnews-social-98b8f89753eb5771:.source_text: Q: When you say tricky, can you pick out for us what exactly you're wrestling with? Still the issues in slow speed or a lack of predictability about what the car is gonna do? "A bit of both. I mean the car is just very very difficult to extract the performance from. I think if you can do it, it's reasonably quick but trying to do it is...as I said yesterday, very very tough. We're continuing to work on it and hopefully we can get there soon."
social:piasnews-social-98b8f89753eb5771:.zh: 问：你说“棘手”，能具体说说你究竟在跟什么较劲吗？还是低速的问题，还是赛车表现缺乏可预测性？“两者都有吧。我的意思是，这辆车就是非常非常难把性能发挥出来。我觉得如果能做到，它其实相当快，但想做到……就像我昨天说的，非常非常艰难。我们还在继续努力，希望很快能解决。”

social:piasnews-social-77446f36b0823b84:.source_text: Q: For these fans, what do you want to say? "Just a massive thank you! Nice, nice to be back, always amazing racing here in Austin so excited to try and put on a good show!" https://t.co/mY8xWMrZM2
social:piasnews-social-77446f36b0823b84:.zh: 问：对这些车迷，你想说些什么？“就是非常感谢大家！很高兴、很高兴能回来，在 Austin 比赛总是很棒，很期待努力献上一场精彩的表演！”

social:piasnews-social-b48656fc4be010a7:.source_text: Q: Has there been a sector or a section that's been challenging to master? "Um...all of them this weekend! But no I mean they're very different sectors here. Obviously sector 1 is very very fast, sector 3 very tight and where we are now is very very tough and technical part of the track so it's a bit different everywhere. But its been challenging in every sector this weekend!"
social:piasnews-social-b48656fc4be010a7:.zh: 问：有没有哪个计时段或路段特别难驾驭？“呃……这个周末所有路段都难！不过说真的，这里的各个计时段差别很大。显然第一计时段非常非常快，第三计时段很紧凑，而我们现在这里是非常非常难、技术性很强的赛道部分，所以各处都不太一样。但这个周末每个计时段都很有挑战性！”

social:piasnews-social-2e8e9a5165409051:.source_text: Q: If this race becomes a battle for strategy rather than pure pace, how aggressive are you willing to be with the tyre life and pitstop timing? "I think from where I'm starting, we've not got too much to lose. So we'll see how the first lap goes and the start goes but yeah. It's gonna be an unknown for everybody. I think whether it's a one stop, two stop. Whether you're on a soft, medium, hard. We're in a reasonable position to take some risk from that side of things."
social:piasnews-social-2e8e9a5165409051:.zh: 问：如果这场比赛变成策略之争而非纯粹的速度比拼，你在轮胎寿命和进站时机上愿意多激进？“我觉得从我的起步位置来看，我们没什么可失去的。所以看看第一圈和起步怎么样吧，但没错。对所有人来说都是未知数。无论是一停还是两停，无论你用软胎、中性胎还是硬胎。从这方面来说，我们处于一个可以承担一些风险的合理位置。”
